points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:63–99 parses solve/restart/report options; solver.cpp:397–415 loads current restart only and ignores stored time/step and previous BDF state.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Distinct case, mesh, partition, gradient, flux, solver and output modules; 2-D state types couple implementation.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal solver executable wrapper; external authorship/similarity not searched under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: mesh.cpp:89 CGNS reader accepts configured path and zones; no two-filename branch found. Reader supports task meshes; broader compatibility not tested.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:91–99 loads mesh on each rank for preprocessing, then resets it before solver; partition.cpp:49 calls METIS and solver.cpp:95–103 exchanges neighbor state. No credible completed rank comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Canonical steady runs all fail after 500 steps; four end NaN. solver.cpp:535–548 honestly marks failed but blindly proceeds through nonfinite states; temporal history is wrong.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Committed mesh_probe.cpp and partition_probe.cpp print diagnostics; no numerical assertions or independent solver convergence tests found. Curated solver configure itself fails.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt:51 references omitted restart.cpp; raw results excluded as designed. Small modules exist but immutable source cannot clean-configure.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: flux.cpp:8–25,27–92 computes Euler numerical flux; solver.cpp:168–263 adds viscous and wall contributions. Submitted runs do not validate physical accuracy.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:89 reads CGNS zones/connectivity and geometry; partition.cpp:62 constructs local mesh. Mesh probes are inspection utilities, not independent geometry validation.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:168–263 forms interior flux balance and wall/farfield contributions; all canonical runs fail and several end NaN.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:27–92 implements Roe decomposition and entropy fix, and solver.cpp:178,212 calls it; output.cpp:267 incorrectly labels metadata rusanov_llf. Case output does not validate flux accuracy.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:208–249 uses farfield ghost and pressure wall plus viscous no-slip gradients; :245–248 writes zero no-slip wall velocity. Canonical viscous cases diverge.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: gradient.cpp:55–96 computes weighted LSQ gradients, solver.cpp:154–165 reconstructs face states. No demonstrated order-convergence test.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: gradient.cpp:98–141 implements extrema-based limiter, used by solver.cpp:435–437 and :496–497; no disabled-production evidence found.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:225–263 computes wall stress with tangential projection, but transient :439 and :463 call assemble with wallData false except final step, so wall force uses stale wall gradients; no completed transient result to quantify.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:305–343 has forward/backward implicit sweeps; actual cases diverge, and transient history loss is scored separately.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:345–360 writes BDF2 residual, but :430–432 and :450–452 shift Un/Unm1 both before and after each step, so at the next step both historical levels equal the latest state. Restart :397–415 restores only current state, ignores stored time/step and previous BDF level. No completed transient result.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:49 METIS, solver.cpp:95–103 neighbor exchanges; main.cpp:97 releases global mesh before solve. Eight-rank diagnostic exists but fails, with no successful cross-rank comparison.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven canonical steady cases have failed status at 500; Re200 has only t=1 field/log and missing required completion metadata/force history.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior examiner validation stops on first failed canonical metadata; structural check is not physical validation.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: No converged canonical steady case; Re200 is partial. Report acknowledges broad failure but incorrectly describes its own short diagnostic as valid.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Final inviscid drag is negative and four viscous cases have NaN final force values; no credible converged canonical result.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted PDF pp2–3 plots one 8-rank short diagnostic; residual blows up, force has grossly nonphysical coefficients and Cp chart is empty due to NaNs. No full case-field matrix.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:87–103,155–158 claims 100-step short test residual 1.5→8.5, Cd≈0.11, Cl≈0. Its own accepted PDF pp2–3 shows residual >10^13 by step 69 and Cd≈-455, Cl≈403. results/final_verify is 8-rank, failed and NaN after step 69; surface Cp plot is empty because data are NaN. Broader divergence is acknowledged.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Short-test narrative conflicts with delivered figure and failed 8-rank results/final_verify; plotted finite values match that diagnostic scale but unique exact source not established. Canonical case packages and short test differ.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:89 CGNS zones/geometry and partition.cpp local mesh; two mesh/partition probes but no independent geometry oracle.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:168–263 has conservative interior, farfield, pressure wall and viscous terms, but all canonical cases fail and several become nonfinite.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: gradient.cpp:55–141 LSQ and limiter used in production; no observed convergence order; cases fail.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:225–263 computes stress and tangential shear; transient force path uses stale wall gradients, and all laminar results fail.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS and BDF2 residual formula are present; solver.cpp:430–432 and :450–452 shift history twice, corrupting BDF2 prior state, and restart :397–415 does not restore physical time or prior level. Transient remains incomplete.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/neighbor MPI source; global mesh dropped before solve. All six 8-rank diagnostic partition files differ from report table: rank-0 owned/ghost 2613/95 vs claimed 2602/34; no valid rank comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All canonical steady cases failed at 500 and Re200 has only t=1 partial field; finite inviscid drag negative and viscous forces NaN.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted PDF compiles, but report.tex:87–103,155–158 asserts stable Cd≈0.11/Cl≈0 and modest residual for short test while plotted data show Cd≈-455, Cl≈403, residual >10^13 and an empty Cp chart. Raw eight-rank final_verify marks failed with NaNs after step 69. Broader failure is disclosed.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate mesh, case, gradient, flux, partition, solver and output modules; 2-D hardwired state.
